output.summary: The dashboard is unreliable: self-reported, no objective criteria, 95% green against 36% on-time on the independent register, with Internal Audit finding 4 of 6 sampled projects behind. The reporting regime (the Nov 2025 memo and the percent-green bonus) plausibly drives inflation. Platform is a secondary factor. CSD files late and incomplete requests (58% returned, 6-day lead time), and complete, early requests succeed 87% of the time. Platform's capacity shortfall slows everyone modestly. Moving engineers and imposing penalty SLAs rests on a misattributed cause. Removing the SVP and unmasking the anonymous commenters are unjustified or harmful. Whether the SVP directed the inflation is unestablished. Fix the measurement and incentives now, and consider a backfill.
